receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt in 'The Forme of Cury' by the Chief Master-Cook of King Richard II, c1390 (Cury 1390)
receipts.receiptText:
SPYNEE
Take and make good thick Almond milk as tofore, And do therein of flour [flower?] of hawthorn and make it as a rose & serve it forth.

receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt in the 15th Century 'Austin Manuscripts' (Austin 1440)
receipts.receiptText: Spyneye: Take the Flowtherys of Hawthorun; boil them & press them, bray them small, temper them up with almond Milke, & lye it with Abyndoun & grated bread & flowre of rice; take sugar y-now & put thereto, or Hony in defawte, & colowre it with the same that the flowrys ben, & serve forth.
